annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1534 of 24 July 2023 selecting the entities forming the initial network of European Digital Innovation Hubs in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2021/694
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1534 of 24 July 2023 selecting the entities forming the initial network of European Digital Innovation Hubs in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2021/694
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 186/33
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision selecting the initial network of European Digital Innovation Hubs under the Digital Europe Programme. Annex I lists hubs retained for funding; Annex II lists hubs awarded a Seal of Excellence. A few hubs focus on robotics or cobots, but the decision is funding administration, not governance of robots.
key_provisions_or_claims: Selects EDIHs forming the initial network under Regulation (EU) 2021/694.
Annex I lists entities retained for Digital Europe Programme funding (136 from first call, 15 from second).
Annex II lists entities awarded the Seal of Excellence for lack of budget.
Enters into force on the twentieth day after publication.
